decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures the first-mint exception in leaderboard reward totals.
A same-message MODIFY already records that the first primary mint awards no $5 referral commission.
A same-message MODIFY already records that the first no-code mint awards neither a random ticket nor a referral commission.
A same-message MODIFY already excludes the first mint from expected ticket and commission accounting totals.
The first-mint reward exception does not change the NFT mint number's identity, persistence, or display as a referral code.
The one-off absence of a first-mint reward does not change which metadata counters and attributes must remain visible and prospectively accurate.
The accepted exception concerns referral tickets and commissions, not the required $5 prize-pool contribution from a primary mint.
The reward exception does not alter the requirement to mint and deliver the NFT ebook.
The decision changes whether the first mint creates a prize ticket, not how an eventual prize winner receives or accesses a prize.
The landing-page copy describes coded referral earnings and prize promotion; the accepted one-off no-code first-mint exception does not necessarily change that copy.
The client explicitly treats the first-mint case as a completed one-off with no future effect, so it does not require changing the prospective no-code validation message.
Not issuing a ticket on the first mint does not change the selection method, ticket weighting, eligible ticket-holder rule, or winner count.
